findings.finding: SB1 Markets (12 Oct) models Q3 adjusted EBITA of SEK 334m on sales of SEK 2,721m (+22%, 4% organic), 6% above the implied consensus of about 315m, at a 12.3% margin. Its stated drivers are Swedish small-house volumes and a Finnish margin recovery, against high gas prices.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q2-26 beat FactSet adjusted EBITA (275m) by 14% at 314m and the stock rose about 15% (baseline 2026-07-15 +15.05%). Q3-25 printed 268m at 12.0% margin, down from 13.4%, and fell 14.2%; Q1-26 fell 7.5% (Finwire table, https://www.placera.se/telegram/inwido-inwido-vantas-redovisa-275-miljoner-kronor-i-justerat-ebita-factset-20260713).
findings.original_quote: Justerad ebita väntas nå 334 miljoner kronor, 6 procent över konsensus, med en marginal på 12,3 procent. Ökad småhusförsäljning i Sverige väntas stödja volymerna, medan höga gaspriser pressar lönsamheten. (Adjusted EBITA is expected to reach SEK 334m, 6% above consensus, at a 12.3% margin. Higher small-house sales in Sweden are expected to support volumes, while high gas prices squeeze profitability.)
findings.why_not_priced: It is one broker against a consensus of about six, and it went out on the Finwire wire, so it is partly priced. If the market fully held 334m, the consensus would have converged up and SB1 would no longer be 6% above it. The stock has risen only about 1% since the note (189.3 on 12 Oct to 188.9). On a $1.6m/day name with a five-to-six analyst consensus that undershot Q2 by 14%, a too-low bar is plausible but not proven.
findings.independence: Partly shares a basis with finding 2 (the Q2 backlog and pricing the broker models from). Four other brokers raised targets 21 Sep-12 Oct (https://www.borskollen.se/aktie/inwido/riktkurs), but that is momentum, not a number.

findings.finding: The Q2 report showed organic order intake +23% and backlog SEK 3,290m (+16% y/y), month-by-month earnings improvement 'from April through May and into June', and 'cautious optimism heading into the second half'. That supports Q3 volumes and pricing, with acquisitions (Sovereign, Marlex consolidated from July, Slovenia, Fast Frame) adding inorganic growth.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q2-26's beat on pricing and organic growth gave about +15%. In Q3-25, 'expectations of seasonal recovery... resulted in under-absorbed costs' and the stock fell 14.2%, so recovery language has failed here before.
findings.why_not_priced: Mostly priced: public for three months, and the stock went from about 169 after Q2 to 189. What is left is the analysts' habit of under-modelling Inwido's pricing pass-through (DNB Carnegie modelled a 10.7% Q2 margin against 11.5% actual, https://www.placera.se/telegram/inwido-inwido-stiger-efter-hojd-riktkurs-fran-dnb-carnegie-bn-20260702). Much of the +23% order intake is one long-dated Scottish project that books over years, which limits what it adds to Q3.
findings.independence: The DNB Carnegie Q2 preview margin miss (above link) is a separate source for the consensus-too-low pattern. Finding 1's broker draws on the same backlog.

findings.finding: Input-cost inflation from the Middle East conflict (aluminium, PVC, glass, energy, transport) was only partly offset in Q2, and the company said more was coming. SB1 flags high gas prices as squeezing Q3 profitability, and Finland had 'significant price pressure' while competitors cut prices for volume.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Margin-led misses have been sold hard: Q3-25 margin 12.0% vs 13.4% gave -14.2%, Q2-25 gave -9.3%, Q1-26 gave -7.5% (Finwire table).
findings.why_not_priced: Largely priced: it is the company's own stated risk, and the SB1 estimate already absorbs it. It stays filed because this name's reaction is asymmetric on margin, and a Q3 margin under the 12.0% comparison would read as a repeat of last October.
findings.independence: SB1 note (https://www.placera.se/telegram/inwido-sb1-upprepar-kop-for-inwido-och-hojer-riktkursen-till-213-kronor-20261012): 'höga gaspriser pressar lönsamheten' (high gas prices squeeze profitability).

findings.finding: Stena, through Stena Adactum (whose CEO Anders Wassberg is an Inwido director), bought 2.5m shares (about SEK 429m) at SEK 170-173 on 14-19 Aug, mid-quarter, becoming largest owner at 10.1%. The FI insider register files it as a closely associated person's purchase.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No prior instance on this name. The stock rose from 172 to 189 in the two months after the purchase.
findings.original_quote: Stena har köpt 2,5 miljoner aktier i Inwido, där fönsterbolagets styrelseledamot Anders Wassberg även är vd för Stena Adactum... Affären var därmed värd knappt 430 miljoner kronor. (Stena has bought 2.5 million shares in Inwido, where board member Anders Wassberg is also CEO of Stena Adactum... the deal was worth just under SEK 430m.)
findings.why_not_priced: Mostly priced: it is two months old and the stock is up about 10% since. What remains is that a party with board access bought heavily mid-Q3, after seeing July-August trading, which is weak evidence against a Q3 disaster. Wassberg called the timing practical: 'tajmingen är inte det avgörande' (the timing is not decisive).

findings.original_quote: 12 okt SB1 Markets höjer Inwido köp 210 → 213 kronor; 01 okt DNB Carnegie höjer Inwido köp 207 → 208 kronor; 24 sep SEB höjer Inwido köp 190 → 200 kronor; 21 sep Handelsbanken höjer Inwido köp 198 → 205 kronor (SB1 Markets raises Inwido to buy, target 210 → 213 kronor, and likewise for the other three brokers)
findings.why_not_priced: Largely priced. Estimate momentum raises the bar as much as it signals a beat, which is why this is sized near zero. It is filed because it means consensus has been rising, so a merely in-line print risks disappointing against the run-up.

The observed report-day reaction table (+12.8, +10.3, +3.1, -3.4, -9.3, -14.2, +2.2, -7.5) came from the Swedish Finwire FactSet preview. It shows a median absolute reaction near 9%, against the baseline's cadence-estimated 2.38%, and is what sets abs_move_pct.

lessons_applied: 'A verified fact is not a predicted reaction' and 'two findings resting on one document': the SB1 estimate (0.8→0.7) and the Q2-backlog finding (0.7→0.5) overlap in basis and were trimmed once each.
The bar rests on one estimate source, not two agreeing ones, so all findings are kept small. p_up went from 56 to 55.

'Keep findings inside the exit window': the 9 Dec CMD and its new financial ambition moved to outside_window. No guidance change is expected in this release, so abs_move_pct is not raised for a guide event.

'You were right about the number and too small about the move': abs_move_pct stays at 8 on the observed ~9% median report-day move rather than the baseline's 2.38. The thin $1-5m turnover band supports that.
Positioning findings that are public and already traded through (Stena 0.3→0.2, target raises 0.2→0.1) were shrunk toward zero.
